notes.title: Minor Update - Windows / Mac / Linux
notes.content:
Hey Friends!

We’re happy that so many of you came to hang out with us at the office, and none of you messed with our machines (right?).

A round of fixes for Windows and Mac (Thank you all who reported bugs, and feature suggestions).

As well as an update for the Linux build that brings it up to date with all other versions. 

Changes :

 Asynchronous achievements - now pop when you get them
 Changed the way things save slightly (switch related)
 Fixed a bug related to the save changes
 Properly recording button presses to save
 Perfectionist achievement fixed


Thanks again to you all, and our friends at Four Quarters (Have you played Loop Hero?)

-ForwardXP

notes.title: Please, Don't Touch Anything 2025 Refresh Update
notes.content:
Please, Don't Touch Anything 2025 Refresh Update
Wow! It's been 9 years since the last update to Please, Don't Touch Anything on Steam. There's an entire generation of gamers who haven't taken a turn at solving the fiendishly mind-bending puzzles, and we wanted to take a moment to update the classic game to ensure it runs great on current Windows and Mac systems.

We've also taken the opportunity to move to the current version of GameMaker, and clean up some bugs that have been bothering us for.. well.. years.

This refresh update will also make it easier to push new updates in the future. We've got a few ideas...


General Changes & Fixes
Updated to latest version of GameMaker

Updated to latest Steamworks SDK and API

Fixed various missing art elements across the game

Added missing animation frame in Bender Ending

Updated deprecated effects used in some endings to use more modern effects

Fixed bug where game would snap back to first monitor when using dual monitors

Fixed custom cursor missing issues

Pressed the red button (Sorry...)


Platform-Specific ChangesWindows
Updated to support Windows 10 & 11 
MacOS
Updated to support MacOS 10.14+

Game updated to run on modern Apple Silicon hardware



We hope you enjoy this update! If you encounter any issues, please reach out to our Support Team at support@forwardxp.com

notes.title: UPDATE AVAILABLE NOW! 6 new endings + Mac OS support
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/DVnqS4K.png

Screwdriver? Check.
Hammer? Check.
All set for some more wicked enigmas.

Please note that some of the new endings are somehow connected to the "old" ones. You might find it useful to delete your save and start the game over. 

The soundtrack DLC has been updated and now includes the musics from the new endings.
